purpose: Mark an action as completed, often with care or effort.
keywords: I finished writing the invitations in one evening.
Grandmother finished baking a round loaf.
restrictions: Used with compatible verbs such as 書く, 作る, 焼く; not freely productive.
mistake: This completion suffix differs from giving something to someone.

segments.role: Mark an action as completed, often with care or effort. Verb stem + 上げる
